bounded_checks.findings: Two repository errors corrected. (1) The capture-oligo partition was modelled as 22 + 25 + 6 with a 'CTAACC' arm; the Supplementary Data 3 rows give 22 + 24 + 7 ('CCTAACC'): the eight canonical oligos share 22 nt of prefix and 7 nt of suffix, and the seven TSQ variants share 46 nt with p-t3-nb01 and differ only in the last 7. selftest.py now derives that partition from the table (skips if the source is absent). (2) The capture panel claimed ligase 'joins the capture 5-prime phosphate at the native C-rich terminus', which is impossible for an oligo annealed to the G-rich overhang via its 3-prime arm; the panel now draws capture oligo + seqTether on the telomere end and states that the Methods do not identify the sealed nick, with the graph's ligation geometry an explicit unavailable(). Added the source-stated T4 ligase conditions, the Pol IV gap-fill conditions and the ProNex 1.6x cleanup (retained post-capture library plus discarded supernatant/ethanol washes) to the graph and captions; adapter caption now names AMII/NA plus Quick T4 ligase. Note rewritten with the verbatim Methods order and the corrected derivation; the supplement is Supplementary Data 3, not 5.
